source_refs.note: 13. Nitroalkanes (CₙH₂ₙ₊₁NO₂) (–C–NO₂): a main subheading of 19.4 Nomenclature of Aliphatic Organic Compounds, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 41-45.

blocks.text: IUPAC naam nitroalkane hai; NO₂ group prefix “nitro” ki shakal mein aata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab beech wali misal ko sirf “nitropropane” kehti hai. Pura naam 1-nitropropane hai, kyun ke NO₂ carbon 1 par hai; isi se yeh 2-nitropropane se alag pehchana jata hai. Oopar sahi naam likha gaya hai.

blocks.prompt: a) In ke systematic naam batayein: i) (CH₃)₃COH ii) CH₃CCl₃ iii) CH₂=CH–CH₂–OH iv) CH₃COC₆H₅ v) CH₂=C(CH₃)COOCH₃
blocks.explanation: i) 2-methylpropan-2-ol; ii) 1,1,1-trichloroethane; iii) prop-2-en-1-ol; iv) 1-phenylethanone (phenylethanone); v) methyl 2-methylpropenoate (methyl 2-methylprop-2-enoate).

blocks.prompt: b) In ke structures banayein: i) 2-methylbutanal ii) propan-2-yl methanoate (kitab mein “prop-2-ylmethanoate”) iii) phenylethanoic acid iv) cyclohexanone v) 3-methylpentanal
blocks.explanation: i) CH₃CH₂CH(CH₃)CHO; ii) HCOOCH(CH₃)₂; iii) C₆H₅CH₂COOH; iv) chhe carbon ka ring jis ke aik carbon par =O ho (C₆H₁₀O); v) CH₃CH₂CH(CH₃)CH₂CHO.

answer_figure.alt: Paanch structural formulas: (i) 2-methylbutanal CH3-CH2-CH(CH3)-CHO; (ii) propan-2-yl methanoate H-C(=O)-O-CH(CH3)-CH3; (iii) phenylethanoic acid, benzene ring-CH2-C(=O)-O-H; (iv) cyclohexanone, chhe konon wala ring jis ke aik kone par =O; (v) 3-methylpentanal CH3-CH2-CH(CH3)-CH2-CHO.
answer_figure.caption: Jawab ka diagram: 2-methylbutanal, propan-2-yl methanoate, phenylethanoic acid, cyclohexanone aur 3-methylpentanal ke structural formulas.
answer_figure.long_description: Har structure ke neeche us ka naam hai. Aldehydes (i, v) mein chain ke aakhir par C=O aur us C par H hai. Ester (ii) mein methanoate wala hissa H–C(=O)–O– hai aur O ke saath propan-2-yl group, CH(CH₃)–CH₃, jura hai. Phenylethanoic acid (iii) mein benzene ring se CH₂ aur phir –COOH group jura hai. Cyclohexanone (iv) chhe carbon ka ring hai jis ke aik carbon par =O hai. Rings ke har kone par aik carbon hai jis par zaroorat ke mutabiq H atoms hain.

items: Naam = prefix + stem (root) + primary suffix + secondary suffix.
Sab se lambi chain lein aur us sire se number karein jo functional group ke qareeb ho.
Family suffix: -ol, -al, -one, -oic acid, -amide, -oyl halide, -oate, -amine, -nitrile; prefix: halo, nitro, alkoxy.
